entities.name: Barl
entities.description: The chief artificer of the Conclave of Mages during the Dark Age on Dominaria, a non-caster who built powerful artifacts.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: The Conclave's leader, who plots with Barl to use Jodah.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A young mage who joins the Conclave and is made to duel Sima by proxy.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: A mage who dabbled in blue mana, suspected of coming from the City of Shadows, who unravels Barl's crossbow.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: The Conclave's founder, imprisoned in Barl's Cage for fifteen-odd years and later released.

entities.name: Primata Delphine
entities.description: A figure Jodah mocked in his interview.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Jodah's great-great-grandfather, a mage who entered Phyrexia and lived to tell the tale.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Jarsyl's grandmother, author of a book on the Antiquities War.

entities.name: Shannan
entities.description: A student Barl sent to ensure Jodah's safety.

entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: A creation of Ith, whose replacement turned out to be created by Barl.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: The mage organization Barl served as chief artificer.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: A magic school opposed to the Conclave.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: A group that attacked the Conclave.

entities.name: Barl's Cage
entities.description: A watersilver cage suspended above a bottomless pit, used to imprison Lord Ith.

entities.name: Stone Calendar
entities.description: A highly detailed timepiece built by Barl from many cogs.

entities.name: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
entities.description: The destruction of the Conclave in which Mairsil died.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the Conclave stood.

events.summary: Barl and Mairsil imprison Lord Ith in Barl's Cage for fifteen-odd years.
events.quote: Barl and Mairsil imprisoned Lord Ith , the founder, in Barl's Cage

events.summary: Barl interviews Jodah, and Mairsil recognizes Jarsyl's name and assigns Jodah to the library.
events.quote: Mairsil told Barl that Jodah was to work in the library.

events.summary: Barl suspects Sima of being from the City of Shadows and reports to Mairsil.
events.quote: Barl suspected that she was from the City of Shadows

events.summary: Mairsil and Barl plot to make Jodah kill Sima in a proxy duel, and Barl prepares both mages.
events.quote: The idea was to get Jodah to kill Sima.

events.summary: Jodah and Sima duel and Jodah wins, and Mairsil goes to finish Sima.
events.quote: Three days later, Jodah and Sima clashed.

events.summary: The Church of Tal attacks the Conclave and Barl organizes the counter-attack, killing one of its members.
Barl catches Jodah and Sima together, threatens them with his crossbow, and Sima unravels it with blue magic so Barl flees.
events.quote: Deprived of his weapon, Barl fled.

events.summary: After the Fall of the Conclave and Mairsil's death, it is revealed that Barl created Ith's replacement Rag Man and received his punishment.
events.quote: The new Rag Man turned out to be created by none other than Barl.

relations.quote: Barl was the chief artificer of the Conclave of Mages

relations.note: built the cage to imprison Ith
